newsitem.title: USA: American International Petroleum awarded damages.
newsitem.headline: American International Petroleum awarded damages.

text.p: American International Petroleum Corp said Monday a Louisiana court awarded the company a $1,550,000 judgment against Gold Line Refining Ltd, primarily for non-payment of lease fees.

American International said it is seeking partners to replace Gold Line and is currently in discussions with parties with a view toward a joint venture to operate the refinery in Lake Charles, La., exclusive of the asphalt operations.
The company also said the erection of all asphalt tanks has been completed and the asphalt polymerization unit has been received and installed.
American International said it expects to start marketing conventional and polymerized asphalt products on its own by mid-June. ((-- New York Newsdesk 212-859-1610.))
